tap2pcap_convert: convert an Envoy tap trace proto file to a PCAP file for Wireshark analysis

tap2pcap_ipv4: convert a tap trace with IPv4 addresses to a PCAP file using text2pcap

tap2pcap_text_proto: parse a tap trace from a .pb_text file and convert it to a PCAP file
